name: Metering-core CT secondary circuit
summary: Identifies the separate CT core supplying the assigned metering circuit.
description: Identifies the separate CT core supplying the assigned metering circuit. A current-transformer secondary arrangement carries a measuring current from a defined primary location to metering or protection inputs. Core identity, polarity and the connected circuit determine the measurement's meaning.

In a substation protection panel, separate CT cores can supply metering and protection circuits with different duties. A test boundary must preserve the secondary arrangement required by the selected CT and test device. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Metering CT core” at the input and “Meter current circuit” at the output. Metering and protection cores are not automatically interchangeable.
